text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, we give the computer training data that includes both inputs and correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, which is like a set of rules it has learned. Later, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can guess if an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy. The more good training data we provide, the better the model usually performs.
